The first season of the American animated web series Battle for Dream Island was first released on YouTube on Cary and Michael Huang's channel jacknjellify on January 1, 2010 with the episode "Take the Plunge", which was released in two parts. The final episode would release on January 2, 2012. The season was produced and directed by Cary and Michael.
Background
In 2009, Cary "had to create a fake catalogue for an algebra class", and inside of it was "a comic about how rock, paper, and scissors... could be improved. [Cary] replaced them with water, sponge, and fire". Cary continued creating comics; he had written a comic inspired by Total Drama Island, titled Total Firey Island. Michael created animations based on Cary's comics, later stating that he wanted to "combine [animation] with Cary's characters".
Later that year, the twins started production on Battle for Dream Island at the age of 12, and released the first episode on January 1, 2010 to their YouTube channel jacknjellify. Like the previous projects by the Huang twins, the show was animated using Adobe Flash. The season ran for two years, and its final episode was released on January 1, 2012.
Episodes
| DirectedBy      =  &
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = While 20 anthropomorphic objects are interacting with each other in a grassland, a dark gray speaker box
called the Announcer descends from the sky and announces the existence of Dream Island, an island designed to be the ultimate paradise, and that whoever owns the island can decide who is allowed onto it. He starts a contest for the island with the 20 objects as contestants.
The first challenge is to see who can stay on a balance beam the longest. Two of the objects, Pin and Leafy, win the first contest and get to organize the teams of the competition; the Squishy Cherries and the Squashy Grapes. The second contest is a race to make a boat and row it to the finish line across a canal, which the Squishy Cherries win.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = Because Pin won the challenge for her team, she obtains a "Win Token", which allows her to halve her votes during the elimination ceremony, called Cake at Stake. Said ceremony is attended by the losing team's members. They get cake slices until there are none left, revealing the eliminated contestant, who will be treated with a vaguely described "TLC". Flower is eliminated with 4 votes, and though she attempts to murder the Announcer with an "Announcer crusher", the crusher explodes and she is sent away. The contest is an obstacle course, won by the Squashy Grapes. Needle obtains a Win Token for finishing the challenge first.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is key lime pie, and Spongy is eliminated with four votes. The contest is a quiz, which is initially won by the Squishy Cherries until it is revealed that Blocky and Pen cheated, giving the victory to the Squashy Grapes. Golf Ball obtains a Win Token for having the highest score on the test.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is ice, and Blocky is eliminated with 6 votes. The contest consists of two parts: to bake cakes that will be rated by Announcer, Flower, and a die, and to eat 100 chocolate balls. The Squashy Grapes win in a tiebreaker, and Pin gains her second Win Token for having the highest scoring cake.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is an ice cream cake, and Woody is eliminated with 9 votes. The "TLC" makes its first physical appearance as a giant metal box called the Tiny Loser Chamber, and Woody is sent there. The contest is to cross a bridge. No one does, so a tiebreaker occurs, which the Squashy Grapes win. No one receives a Win Token in this episode.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is cupcakes, and Pin is eliminated with 5 votes. The teams are temporarily split into five teams of three, and the contest is to get across 3 islands.
On island 1, the contestants are tasked with looking through safes to find rafts and paddles. Island 2 has ten keys hanging from poles, which are used to unlock a locked building on island 3. However, five of the keys are fake, forcing their holders to go back to island 2 and get another key. Coiny, Ice Cube, and Needle lose the contest, and Eraser, Firey, and Pen all get Win Tokens for finishing first.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is key lime pie again, and Needle is eliminated with 12 votes, even after halving her votes to 6 with a win token. When the TLC doesn't close properly, Pencil points out that it has already reached its maximum capacity. Therefore, the Announcer decides that the winners get to take a contestant from the losing team, with no one getting eliminated. The contest is to solve a jigsaw puzzle, won by the Squashy Grapes. Per the Announcer's decision, Squashy Grapes choose Firey to switch to their team. No one receives a Win Token in this episode.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The contest is a race where each contestant has to carry one of their other team members, except for the last contestant, who doesn't carry anyone. The Announcer also promises a prize for the winning team, and that no one is eliminated again. Because the Squashy Grapes have more members than the Squishy Cherries at this point, five of them are chosen by the wheel to participate: Firey, Ice Cube, Leafy, Golf Ball, and Rocky. The Squashy Grapes win, and their prize is that they get to have an eliminated player on their team. No one receives a Win Token in this episode.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = Blocky rejoins the game on the Squashy Grapes with 8 votes, which are then split into the Squashy Grapes (Blocky, Ice Cube, Leafy, Snowball and Teardrop) and Another Name (Coiny, Firey, Golf Ball, Rocky and Tennis Ball). Blocky receives a Win Token for rejoining.
A new elimination system is introduced, in which the two most voted contestants from the team that was last are voted on by the team that placed first; one contestant will join the winning team, and the other will be eliminated. The contest is a six-legged race, in which Squishy Cherries place first and Squashy Grapes in last.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is modelling clay, with the bottom two being Teardrop and Snowball, at 5 and 18 votes respectively. Teardrop is eliminated from a 3-2 vote, with Snowball being moved to the Squishy Cherries. The contest, which is for each team to fill their tub as much as they can with tears, ends in a tie. The tiebreaker is a skiing contest in which the Squishy Cherries and Another Name are rolled into snowballs, needing an additional tiebreaker; a handstanding contest won by the Squishy Cherries. Eraser gains a Win Token for handstanding the longest.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = Starting from this episode onward, the show would feature fan-made recommended characters from viewers, with Bomby being the first under this title.
The Cake at Stake is an imaginary cake, with the bottom two being Golf Ball, at 12 votes (6 after using her win token), and Rocky, at 15. Golf Ball is eliminated from a 0-6 vote, with Rocky moved to the Squishy Cherries. The contest is try to stay up in the air with balloons, which the Squashy Grapes win and Another Name lose. No one receives a Win Token in this episode.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake has no cake, with the bottom two being Tennis Ball and Coiny at 22 and 30 votes, respectively. Leafy picks Tennis Ball for the Squashy Grapes, eliminating Coiny. The teams and Win Tokens are removed and replaced with a points leaderboard where the bottom third go to Cake at Stake. Firey, Pen, Blocky, and Eraser earn 15 points for each token they had. The contest is to climb ladders.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is fish, with the bottom third being Snowball, Bubble, Rocky, and Tennis Ball. Snowball is eliminated with 47 votes. The contest is to find and bring a red ball to the Announcer. There are also maroon balls, which subtract points instead of adding them.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is fruitcake, with the bottom third being Match, Ice Cube, Rocky, and Tennis Ball. Match is eliminated with 66 votes. The eliminated contestants get a contest to carry loaves to their basket until the deadline, won by Spongy, who rejoins the competition and gains 38 points, one for each loaf of bread carried. The next contest is to jump over obstacles on a conveyor belt. Blocky and Bubble last the longest.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is nickels, with the bottom third being Ice Cube, Leafy, Eraser, and Firey. Eraser is eliminated with 99 votes. There are two contests: to stay on floating islands in a giant barf bag, and to make a taco rated by the eliminated contestants.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is an explosive blueberry pie, with the bottom third being Pen, Bubble, and Rocky. Pen is eliminated with 144 votes. The contest is bowling, and everyone is sent to Cake at Stake besides Firey, who earned immunity by bowling a strike.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is knives, and Blocky is eliminated with 112 votes. The contest is to throw and catch frisbees as a pair. Announcer reveals that the contestants will vote on who is eliminated, and the viewers will instead vote on one of thirty fan-made characters ("recommended characters") to join the competition. The characters eligible for entry are 8-Ball, Balloony, Barf Bag, Basketball, Bell, Bomby, Book, Clock, Cloudy, David, Dora, Eggy, Evil Leafy, Fanny, Fries, Grassy, Marker, Naily, Nickel, Nonexisty, Pie, Pillow, Remote, Robot Flower, Roboty, Ruby, Saw, Taco, Tree and TV.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The eliminated contestants plot their escape from the TLC, but the Announcer appears and tells them to stop planning. The Cake at Stake is a cracker, and Leafy and Tennis Ball tie for elimination with two votes. The tiebreaker is to jump over a gap, eliminating Tennis Ball who falls. David joins the game as the recommended character with 102 votes. The other recommended characters are sent to the Locker of Losers (LOL), a huge, navy blue box similar to the TLC, with a lock to prevent attempts of escape.
The scoreboard gets downgraded, so it can only hold two-digit numbers. The contest is a staring contest, won by Pencil. While the staring contest is underway, the eliminated contestants attempt to escape the TLC, which backfires and they nearly drown in the river until they are saved by the sunrise. When points are given out, Pencil's score overflows, and she ends up in the bottom third.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Cake at Stake is shovels covered in mud. The bottom three are Spongy, Firey, and Pencil; Pencil is eliminated with 259 votes.
From this point on, points no longer exist; contestants now obtain immunity by winning challenges.
The contest is to race on unicycles, won by Bubble, Rocky, and Firey. For winning first, Bubble is allowed to choose another contestant to have immunity, choosing Leafy.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = Announcer moves the competition to outer space due to "budget cuts". The Cake at Stake is ice cream cake again, with Spongy, Ice Cube, and David up for voting. David is eliminated with 331 votes. The contest is to get in a spaceship and shoot lasers at other contestants. Bubble wins, and once again picks Leafy to have immunity alongside her. Announcer invites the viewers to vote on an eliminated contestant to rejoin the game, while the non-immune contestants will be voted on by the previously eliminated.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The contestants return to Earth. There is no Cake at Stake item; Ice Cube is the most voted to be eliminated. Flower rejoins the game with 205 votes. The contest is a long jump competition, won by Leafy, although she gives up her immunity to Spongy because she feels bad for having used him as fuel for the spaceship.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Announcer gets crushed by Spongy, so Firey and Flower bring out their personal speaker boxes to host. The Cake at Stake is "yoylecake" (a cake composed of fictional "yoyleberries"), and Rocky is eliminated with 319 votes. The contest is to escape a volcano. The contestants all tie, so Firey and Flower's Speaker Boxes do a beauty contest. They declare their creators as the winners, giving Firey and Flower immunity.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = The Announcer gets recovered, more speaker boxes show up, and the Cake at Stake is cheese slices. Spongy is eliminated with 432 votes. The contest is to complete every previous contest in order from episode 1 to 22. Near the end, Bubble and Leafy argue about their friendship, and then Flower kills Leafy. Bubble then kills Flower and proceeds to win immunity. Firey is given a penalty (holding a sign asking the viewers to vote for him) for performing poorly during the challenge.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = Firey and Leafy hang out in the former's ferris wheel. However, Firey installed a lava fall on it. Unable to escape, Leafy is burned to death. She doesn't get recovered for Cake at Stake, as the Announcer sold the recovery centers due to "budget cuts". Firey doesn't believe him, so he bets his life savings. Announcer accepts the bet and tells Firey that the recovery centers really were sold.
Announcer abruptly cancels the show after seeing that they received fewer votes than last time. Flower throws a nest of bug eggs at the Announcer in anger, causing bugs to infest the area, and everyone runs, attempting to save themselves. None of the contestants survive: Firey, the TLC prisoners, and all the recommended characters are devoured by the bugs, Flower gets hit by a meteor and falls into a canyon, and the Announcer pops Bubble because she learned he made the bugs. The Announcer eventually finds a button that deletes the bug swarm, and realizes that David survived because he is immune to them. The Announcer continues the competition with clones of David. The Cake at Stake is red velvet cake, and Flower is eliminated with 524 votes. At that point, the contestants suddenly come back, all having faked their deaths. There is no contest, so the Announcer invites the viewers to vote who should win Dream Island. In addition, the Announcer promises that a second season will only happen if they receive 1,000 votes.
In the stinger, it is revealed that the Announcer bought new recovery centers for the final 3 and himself with Firey's life savings.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
&
| OriginalAirDate =
| ShortSummary    = After releasing the eliminated contestants, the Announcer holds the final Cake at Stake for Bubble, Leafy and Firey. There were only 870 votes, which supposedly meant no Season 2 would occur. The cake is a Grand Cake, made up of all the previous cakes. Before the Announcer can declare the winner, Flower damages him, affecting his speech. With 406 out of 870 votes, Firey wins the cake and Dream Island.
When choosing who gets to enter, Firey lets everyone in except for runner-up Leafy, who he excludes because he was hurt by her wanting to get off his ferris wheel. Angered, Leafy buys Dream Island from the Announcer. When the other contestants find Dream island missing, they head outside to search for it, while Tennis Ball, Match, Snowball and Woody are beamed up by the Announcer's UFO. After Bubble calls out Flower for her behavior, the latter destroys all of the recovery centers in a fit of rage and pops the former. She is in turn crushed to death by the UFO. It is also revealed that Woody died from fear of the UFO's gray color. Announcer and the other speaker boxes leave on the UFO back to their home. When the others find out about Leafy stealing Dream Island, they threaten to kill her via Flower's announcer crusher. Before she is crushed, Firey swoops in using a hang glider and saves her, telling her that he values their friendship more than the island, as they fly away towards the sunset.
| LineColor       = FF5F5F
}}
}}

Contestants
There are 21 contestants who competed in Battle for Dream Island. They are Blocky, Bubble, Coiny, David, Eraser, Firey, Flower, Golf Ball, Ice Cube, Leafy, Match, Needle, Pen, Pencil, Pin, Rocky, Snowball, Spongy, Teardrop, Tennis Ball, and Woody. Many of the characters return in later seasons as contestants.
